suites.title: Apply for Leave: validation and boundary errors are handled

specs.title: empty required fields block submission with no request created
End Date earlier than Start Date is rejected
a past Start Date is blocked or flagged
requesting more days than the remaining balance is rejected
an empty Reason is blocked by required-field validation
user can log out and log back in, landing on Dashboard
LV-NG-01: employeeSelf (no leaves.apply.any) has no way to target another employee
LV-UI-05: toggling Half Day forces end_date = start_date and hides the End Date field
LV-UI-08: LeaveAllocationChart (Allocated vs Used) renders on the employee dashboard
LV-UI-09: ApprovalsQueueCard renders "Pending Approvals" and deep-links into /leaves, with no duplicate approve/reject action
LV-UI-10: the "Team Time Off" / "Global Time Off" 7-day strip renders on the manager dashboard
LV-UI-11: the date-picker minimum is hardcoded to 2026-01-01 rather than computed from today (known gap)
LV-VD-01: submitting with type/start_date/end_date missing is blocked by required-field browser validation
PA-BD-12 (confirmed gap): no "Approaching limit" chip exists anywhere in the Storage Usage section, for any company, at any usage ratio
PA-UI-01: an invalid email format shows inline client-side validation
PA-UI-02: an empty password shows inline client-side validation
PA-UI-03: a mocked 401/429 login response is surfaced in the top-level Alert
PA-UI-04: typing in the search box filters the company list (debounced)
PA-UI-05: cycling the status filter changes which companies are listed
PA-UI-11: Profile/Tenant Health/Usage/Provisioning History tabs each render their own content with no cross-tab leakage
PA-UI-12: the employee-usage "Approaching limit" chip is absent for a company comfortably under its plan limit
PA-UI-13/PA-SC-10: provisioning history never renders a plaintext password, even for a real historical entry
PA-UI-14: navigating to a protected Platform Admin route while unauthenticated redirects to /platform-admin/login
PA-UI-15: an access-token expiry with a failed refresh signs the user out and redirects to login
empty fields block submission via required-field validation
a New/Confirm Password mismatch is rejected
an incorrect Current Password is rejected by the server
VC-FN-06 (UI half): SHOW_TEAM navigates immediately with no confirmation modal and no /voice/execute call
